When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition.
An Endorsement to the said effect is also made by the learned counsel for the petitioner in the Petition today.
Recording the submission of the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
